title: Determine the supported Beads read model
description:
## Question

Which supported Beads 1.x interfaces should a local read-only web application use to load current work items, labels, comments, statuses, parent links, blocking dependencies, and detect changes without corrupting or locking the repository? Compare CLI JSON, direct Dolt or SQL access, passive JSONL, and any supported API; identify compatibility and version constraints and recommend a boundary.
close_reason: Decision recorded: use version-gated, short-lived read-only bd CLI snapshots.

comments.author: Helio Pais
comments.text:
## Decision

Use the installed `bd` CLI as the sole Beads boundary. Read a complete local snapshot through a short-lived `bd --readonly -C <repository> export` process; normalize issues, labels, comments, raw statuses, parent-child links, and blocking dependency types in an app-owned adapter. Hydrate only missing dependency endpoints with bounded `bd --readonly ... show <id...> --json` calls so path-relevant system nodes can appear without loading all infrastructure or memories.

Require `bd >= 1.1.0, < 2.0.0`: 1.0.x has the JSON surface, but official 1.0.4 reports show nominal reads could mutate passive JSONL in embedded edge cases, while 1.1.0 explicitly guarantees read-only behavior through the embedded store. Detect change by polling short-lived exports and comparing a canonical content hash; retain the last good snapshot on transient lock/errors. Do not use long-lived `bd list --watch`, direct Dolt/SQL, passive `.beads/issues.jsonl`, implicit `bd dolt pull`, or MCP as the app data plane.

Primary sources:
- https://github.com/gastownhall/beads/blob/v1.0.4/docs/COMMUNITY_TOOLS.md
- https://github.com/gastownhall/beads/blob/v1.0.4/cmd/bd/export.go
- https://github.com/gastownhall/beads/blob/v1.0.4/internal/types/types.go
- https://github.com/gastownhall/beads/blob/v1.0.4/beads.go
- https://github.com/gastownhall/beads/releases/tag/v1.1.0
- https://github.com/gastownhall/beads/issues/4033
- https://github.com/gastownhall/beads/issues/3415
- https://github.com/gastownhall/beads/blob/main/docs/INSTALLING.md

Full rationale and local verification: `docs/research/beads-read-model.md` on branch `research/beads-read-model`, commit `fe6a01a` (https://github.com/heliopais/beads-map/commit/fe6a01a).

title: Specify the Beads Map read-only dependency explorer
description:
## Destination

Produce a build-ready product and technical specification for Beads Map: a CLI-launched, local, read-only web application that lets a developer inspect current work and its dependency graph for one Beads repository at a time, while switching among repositories without aggregating their graphs.

## Notes

Use the `grilling` and `domain-modeling` skills for human decision tickets. This map plans the product and technical specification; implementation is outside the map.

Standing boundaries fixed while charting:
- The graph workspace is the primary surface.
- Dependency edges represent blocking only; parent-child organization is separate.
- Human-facing work records are normal nodes; path-relevant system records may appear compactly.
- Closed work remains connected and dimmed by default.
- Execution state is derived as Completed, In progress, Ready, Blocked, or Deferred.
- The active graph auto-refreshes while preserving view state.
- The repository catalog is explicit, local, recent/pinned, and never aggregates graphs.
- Current state only; no historical time travel.

Primary upstream reference: https://github.com/gastownhall/beads

## Decisions so far

<!-- Closed decision tickets are indexed here. -->

- [Determine the supported Beads read model](beads:beads-map-lnd.7): Use short-lived, read-only `bd export` snapshots with targeted `show` hydration behind a tolerant adapter; require Beads >=1.1,<2 and poll/hash snapshots instead of reading Dolt/JSONL or using `--watch`.

## Not yet specified

- Exact implementation stack, process boundaries, testing strategy, and compatibility policy beyond what becomes clear from the read-model research and interaction prototype.
- The final specification packaging and handoff shape after product and architecture decisions converge.
- Detailed recovery and diagnostic behavior that depends on the chosen Beads integration boundary.

## Out of scope

- Creating, editing, claiming, closing, or otherwise mutating Beads records.
- Cross-repository dependency graphs or aggregate portfolio views.
- Hosted service, team collaboration, or stakeholder-reporting features.
- Historical playback, trends, or state-as-of views.
- Implementing the application within this Wayfinder effort.
